title: Coherent exact direct-image coefficient family
statement:
Fix universes u and w, a prime natural number l, and an algebraic closure Ω : Type w of ℚ_[l], with its given field and algebra structures. Let X and Y be schemes in universe u, each Noetherian and of finite topological Krull dimension, with l invertible in every stalk. Write dT and iT for the respective dimension and invertibility witnesses for each scheme T. All preservation hypotheses, functors, comparisons and conclusions are quantified exactly as follows.

theorem pbcDirectImageCoherentFamily (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (pres : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualDerivedPush f (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj)) :
    ∃ F : StageSystem.CoherentExactMorphism
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out),
      (∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω,
        F.base.Φ E = pbcDescentDirectImage l Ω f pres E) ∧
      PbcDirectImageBetaSpec l Ω f pres F.base

Here the category, scalar system, operation functors, and canonical BetaSpec are those of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category], [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport] and [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. The exact-family and actual rational-pullback interfaces are [def-weil-pbc-descent-interfaces]; the actual rational direct image and its beta predicate are [def-per-rational-direct-image-family].

source.place: Final paragraph, scalar-compatible direct-image operations; Lean module Sheaf.Paper.PbcDirectImageCoherentFamily, declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pbcDirectImageCoherentFamily

proof.text: Identify the normalized completed coefficient maps with the raw small-field maps. Conjugate the scalar direct-image comparisons, retaining their component HEq by an existence-and-specification lemma. Cancel the intermediate Shrink equivalence to identify composite small-field inclusions; use the derived restriction adjunction normalization to identify associators. Transfer the ambient scalar coefficient tower equation to obtain an ambient StageSystem.Morphism. Restrict to the full integral subcategories and reflect coherence through their faithful inclusions. Localize the family by lifting comparison isomorphisms through fully faithful precomposition. The comparison equation on integral representatives reflects the coefficient coherence. Conjugating the rational comparison by the two scalar/integral comparisons cancels to the localization of the restricted ambient mate. Its ambient component HEq identifies it with the unique comparison specified in pbcScalarDirectImage_rational, proving BetaSpec. Finally apply the exact-structure theorem to this explicitly constructed fixed normalized family.

proof_origin.place: Explicit ambient/integral/rational family construction, coefficient coherence and BetaSpec normalization; exact structure supplied separately, 2026-10-22.

split_report.summary: Prove the actual normalized direct-image coefficient family and its BetaSpec by restriction and localization, and attach exact structures using the separate fixed-family exactness result.
split_report.blueprint: Serves the final operations/exchange sentence of prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors; the general descent and the unit route remain. Searches of the whole blueprint for scalar-compatible and exchange maps find the parent proposition and more specialized exchange nodes, but no separate equivalent statement.
split_report.edge_cases: Identity morphisms, empty schemes, repeated coefficient fields, independently sized coefficient algebraic closures, and proof-irrelevant preservation witnesses keep the same statement.
